programs.title: VET TEC 2.0 — High-Tech Training
programs.summary: VA education benefit for eligible Veterans and transitioning service members pursuing approved short-term, non-degree high-tech training.
programs.geography: Nationwide; approved providers and distance-learning options vary
programs.cost_note: For eligible participants, VA pays approved tuition and fees directly to the school and may provide housing payments, books and supplies. Check payment amounts, remaining entitlement rules and any uncovered costs with VA.
programs.eligibility_to_check: VA eligibility: Veteran discharged under conditions other than dishonorable or active-duty member within 180 days of separation; at least 36 months of active duty; under age 62 at approval. Confirm that the chosen training program is VA-approved.
programs.important_to_know: VET TEC 2.0 differs from the pilot that ended in 2024. VA reported 2,022 remaining participant openings as of November 10, 2026; that is a dated snapshot, not guaranteed current capacity. VA currently lists three distance-learning providers with location restrictions. Provider enrollment, course availability and individual eligibility are not confirmed.
programs.first_step: Visit the official VA VET TEC 2.0 page to review eligibility, approved training providers and its online application.

programs.title: Veterans’ Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — 2026 Premium Holiday
programs.summary: VA has announced a temporary premium holiday, November 1, 2026–January 31, 2027, for eligible Veterans’ Group Life Insurance policyholders.
programs.cost_note: Eligible VGLI premiums are waived for covered months. Existing overdue balances, the required first premium for newly effective policies, and payments for other months are not waived.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Whether your VGLI coverage was active November 1, 2026, or became effective during November or December 2026, and the applicable billing method.
programs.important_to_know: This is a time-limited change to existing VGLI insurance, not a new product. The relief generally applies automatically, but the number of covered months depends on when a policy becomes effective. Personal policy status has not been checked.
programs.first_step: Visit VA’s VGLI program page and premium holiday FAQ, then check your own policy statement.

verification.application_status: VGLI holiday effective under VA's published coverage conditions; individual status not checked
